Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

1. If he/she is drawing pension through any bank included in the Second Schedule to the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the life certificate may be signed by an officer of the Bank.
2. An authorized official of the Embassy of India/ High Commission of India/ Indian Consulates may issue the life certificate.
